cards.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
cards.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hide this envelope under the picnic hamper before anyone comes in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's in it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Something easier to explain once it isn't visible.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Am I involved now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only at the hamper level. We can discuss promotion later.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hide this envelope under the picnic hamper before Mum comes in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked me to unpack the hamper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then keep the envelope in your pocket while you unpack.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll end up taking it home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. I'll explain when she stops asking where it is.

beats.text: I'll explain tomorrow. That's the last bus.

beats.text: I'll drive you. What happened to that hour?
